tasks.subject: Task 1: Pure half — Fake Keyboard parser, env builder, fixture mode
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Host-tested, libc-only helpers that turn a `/proc/bus/input/devices` snapshot into gptokeyb's `/dev/input/eventN` (highest `inputN` wins) and build the `SDL_EVDEV_DEVICES` string, exposed through a `--fake-kbd` fixture mode of the test binary.

**Files:**
- Modify: `assets/gt-input-remap.c` — pure-half includes (~line 71); new helpers `gt_read_whole`, `gt_fake_kbd_resolve`, `gt_evdev_env_build` inserted immediately before `#ifdef GT_REMAP_TEST` (~line 766); `main(int argc, char **argv)` with `--fake-kbd <file>` mode (~line 780); inline asserts before `puts("remap ok");` (~line 1199)
- Create: `tests/fixtures/input-devices/rgsp-gptokeyb.txt` (rgsp.txt + one Fake Keyboard stanza input5/event3)
- Create: `tests/fixtures/input-devices/rgsp-gptokeyb-two.txt` (rgsp.txt + input5/event4 + input6/event3)
- Create: `tests/test-30-gptokeyb-passthrough.sh` (part A)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `cc -DGT_REMAP_TEST -O2 -Wall` compiles on the host with no warnings from the new code
- [ ] `remap-test` with no arguments still prints exactly `remap ok` and exits 0 (test-05 / test-26 contract)
- [ ] `--fake-kbd rgsp.txt` → `none`; `--fake-kbd rgsp-gptokeyb.txt` → `/dev/input/event3`; `--fake-kbd rgsp-gptokeyb-two.txt` → `/dev/input/event3` (input6 beats input5 despite event4 > event3)
- [ ] `--fake-kbd /nonexistent` exits 1
- [ ] Inline asserts: env string `3:/dev/input/event3`; too-small buffer fails; `Fake Keyboards` rejected; stanza without Sysfs ignored; empty buffer → none; handler directly after `=` and no trailing newline resolves

**Verify:** `sh tests/test-30-gptokeyb-passthrough.sh && sh tests/test-05-input-remap.sh && sh tests/test-26-controller-layout-shim.sh` → `test-30-gptokeyb-passthrough OK`, no assert output, `test-26-controller-layout-shim OK`

tasks.subject: Task 2: Interposer half — passthrough at SDL init, announce, joystick gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** In the game process, the first `SDL_Init`/`SDL_InitSubSystem` call with `SDL_INIT_VIDEO` detects a running gptokeyb, waits (≤2 s) for its node, exports `SDL_EVDEV_DEVICES`, unloads the gptk, and announces once; the constructor stops logging; joystick opens follow synthesis only.

**Files:**
- Modify: `assets/gt-input-remap.c` — interposer half: prototype `static void gt_announce(void);` after the includes (~line 1214); constructor rewritten silent with `gt_gptk_status/gt_gptk_path/gt_gptk_n` (~1398–1423); new F54 block after the constructor (`enum gt_pt_state_e`, `gt_comm_is_gptokeyb`, `gt_gptokeyb_running`, `gt_fake_kbd_node`, `gt_passthrough_decide`, `gt_passthrough_on_init`, `gt_announce`, `SDL_Init`, `SDL_InitSubSystem`); `gt_ensure_joystick_open` gate `if (done || !gt_map.loaded) return;` (~1454); `gt_announce();` first in `SDL_PollEvent`, `SDL_WaitEventTimeout`, `SDL_GL_SwapWindow`, `eglSwapBuffers`, `SDL_RenderPresent`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Decision runs once, only when `flags & SDL_INIT_VIDEO`; static guard makes the PLT re-entry a no-op
- [ ] Preconditions in order: `GT_PASSTHROUGH=="0"` → disabled; `SDL_EVDEV_DEVICES` non-empty → preset; `/proc/self/comm` starts with `gptokeyb` → self
- [ ] Detection: `/proc/<pid>/comm` prefix `gptokeyb`, own pid skipped, no session filter
- [ ] Wait: 50 ms polls, 2000 ms total, only when gptokeyb runs and no node resolves
- [ ] Activation before the real init: `setenv("SDL_EVDEV_DEVICES", "3:/dev/input/eventN", 1)`, `gt_map.loaded = 0`, state active
- [ ] Constructor prints nothing; records gptk status
- [ ] `gt_announce()` once per process, silent inside gptokeyb, order: `gt-input-remap: loaded`; `gt-input-remap: HUD enabled`; passthrough line (`gt-input-remap: gptokeyb passthrough -> %s (synthesis off)` / `... running but no Fake Keyboard node after %d ms -> synthesis fallback` / `... not evaluated (no SDL init seen)`; debug-only variants for no-gptokeyb/disabled/preset); synthesis line (`keyboard synthesis on, %d mapping(s) from %s` / `keyboard synthesis off (gptokeyb passthrough)` / `cannot open GT_REMAP_GPTK=%s`)
- [ ] `gt_ensure_joystick_open` returns unless `gt_map.loaded`
- [ ] Host build under `-DGT_REMAP_TEST` still passes

**Verify:** `cc -DGT_REMAP_TEST -O2 -Wall -o /dev/null assets/gt-input-remap.c && sh tests/test-05-input-remap.sh && sh tests/test-26-controller-layout-shim.sh && sh tests/test-30-gptokeyb-passthrough.sh` → pass (interposer half compiles in Task 5's `make shim`)

Full steps with code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-gptokeyb-passthrough.md, Task 2.

tasks.subject: Task 3: gt-preload-append.sh helper with host test
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A POSIX sh helper that rewrites overwrite-style `export LD_PRELOAD=<value>` lines in a launcher to prepend `${GT_LD_PRELOAD}`, idempotently, without touching launchers that have no such line.

**Files:**
- Create: `assets/gt-preload-append.sh` (mode 755; grep for candidates, `sed` to a temp file, `cat` back — no `sed -i`)
- Modify: `tests/test-30-gptokeyb-passthrough.sh` (append part B before the final echo)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `export LD_PRELOAD=hacksdl.so` → `export LD_PRELOAD="${GT_LD_PRELOAD}${GT_LD_PRELOAD:+:}"hacksdl.so`
- [ ] Quoted-variable value, indented line, and trailing `# comment` variants: prefix inserted, rest byte-identical
- [ ] Append-style line (`...:$LD_PRELOAD`) and commented `# export LD_PRELOAD=` untouched
- [ ] Empty `export LD_PRELOAD=` → `export LD_PRELOAD="${GT_LD_PRELOAD}${GT_LD_PRELOAD:+:}"`
- [ ] Second run is byte-identical; a launcher without candidates keeps inode and mtime; a patched launcher keeps its inode (exec bit survives)
- [ ] Sourcing a patched line with `GT_LD_PRELOAD=/pak/a.so:/pak/b.so` → `LD_PRELOAD=/pak/a.so:/pak/b.so:hacksdl.so`; with empty snapshot → `hacksdl.so`
- [ ] Portable: BSD sed (macOS host) and busybox sed

**Verify:** `sh tests/test-30-gptokeyb-passthrough.sh` → `test-30-gptokeyb-passthrough OK`

Full steps with code: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-04-gptokeyb-passthrough.md, Task 3.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Device gate on the RG SP (Camille's hands)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Every passthrough behavior is verified on hardware before merge, or each failure is recorded with its log excerpt in the F54 section.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Modify: `docs/h700-fixes.md` (replace the F54 "Device gate" placeholder paragraph with dated results)

**Setup:** `make pak`, install `dist/Emus/h700/PORTS.pak.zip` on the RG SP (`ssh root@10.0.1.16`) with PortMaster idle; never overwrite a running `.sh` in place; one port session at a time; read `.userdata/h700/logs/PORTS.txt` after each launch (truncated per launch). Optional `use-input-debug` flag file for debug lines.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] BYTEPATH (allowlisted as shipped): menus + ship movement work; log has `gt-input-remap: gptokeyb passthrough -> 3:/dev/input/event` and `keyboard synthesis off (gptokeyb passthrough)`; no `joystick(s) for key synthesis`; exactly one `gt-input-remap: loaded`
- [ ] BYTEPATH removed from the allowlist (temporary copy of files/gt-remap-ports.txt, restored after): same gameplay; passthrough line present; no `Enabling input remap`
- [ ] Tunics!: A works on the title screen, in-game movement works, no doubled actions; log has `Enabling input remap` AND the passthrough line
- [ ] Sonic 1: log has `gptokeyb passthrough disabled (blocklisted) for Sonic 1.sh` and `keyboard synthesis on, `; jump/pause as in v0.4.0
- [ ] OpenTTD with a d-pad-to-mouse gptk: cursor moves with the d-pad and a click lands on a toolbar button
- [ ] OpenTTD text field (town rename or save name) shows typed characters
- [ ] Doom Engines Crispy shareware (after the v0.4.1 pins are on the device): engine log has `gt-input-remap: loaded` + passthrough line; WASD/Enter drive menu and game
- [ ] HUD Menu tap toggles the overlay; power press suspends, next power press resumes with sound, during a passthrough port
- [ ] Select+Start quits the port and NextUI's menu is responsive afterwards
- [ ] Balatro: one press = one action under passthrough
- [ ] Results (PASS/FAIL per gate, date, log excerpts for failures) written into the F54 section and committed

**Verify:** the F54 "Device gate" paragraph in `docs/h700-fixes.md` lists all ten gates with a PASS/FAIL each.
